hook.name: PercentProfitHarvestOnZeroHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that overrides the LP fee dynamically per swap direction (configurable for zeroForOne, zero for oneForZero) and charges an owner-configurable hook swap fee (up to 0.01%) taken from the output token after each swap. Accrued fees are held by the hook contract and claimable by the owner.
